customer.target: Korean adults in their 20s-30s who often take 30+ minutes to fall asleep but would not see a doctor for it, and who already play sleep sounds, ASMR or music at bedtime. They live in Korea and pay in Korean won: every price you answer must be in KRW per month (for example 4900). Income figures are shown as a US-dollar equivalent
customer.where: Korea, mostly Seoul metro and other cities; app stores (Google Play and App Store)

behaviours.name: Free YouTube sleeper
behaviours.how: Plays free YouTube sleep music or ASMR every night with a 30-minute sleep timer and has never paid for a sleep app.

behaviours.name: Hard sleeper
behaviours.how: Takes 30+ minutes to fall asleep three or more nights a week and has tried several apps and tricks.

behaviours.name: Trial-then-cancel
behaviours.how: Starts free trials often and cancels before paying; has been charged once after forgetting to cancel.

behaviours.name: Reads reviews and evidence
behaviours.how: Checks app-store ratings and wants proof before believing a health-ish claim.

behaviours.name: Value hunter
behaviours.how: Already pays for several subscriptions and cuts anything that does not feel worth it each month.

behaviours.name: Already pays for a sleep app
behaviours.how: Subscribes to Calm or Renight and is used to it.

objections: YouTube sleep music is free, why pay?
Even 4,900 won a month feels like too much for a sleep app
Will it really make me fall asleep faster, or is that just marketing?
Doing a morning check-in every day sounds like a chore
If it turns the sound back on by mistake at 3am it will wake me up
Subscription apps have charged me after a free trial before
My AirPods already stop the sound when I fall asleep
Where does my sleep data go?
habits: you scroll your phone in bed for 30+ minutes before sleeping
you play sleep sounds through a Bluetooth speaker, not earphones
you fall asleep with earphones in
you usually wake up once around 3-4am and struggle to fall back asleep
your bedtime changes every week because of your schedule
you use an iPhone and AirPods

pitch:
SLEEP:ON Pro, 14일 잠들기 체험: 잠들면 조용해지고, 깨면 끊긴 그 자리부터 다시 이어지는 수면음.
오늘 밤에 맞는 소리를 앱이 직접 만들고, 첫날 밤엔 '평소 몇 분 걸려요?' 한 가지로 시작해 아침 10초 체크로 매일 끄는 시점을 맞춰 감. 깨면 잠금 화면에서 버튼 한 번으로 끊긴 소리가 이어짐(심박 암밴드를 연결하면 자동으로 이어지는 기능은 2028년 예정, 암밴드는 별도 구매). 워치가 있으면 얕은 잠일 때 깨워 줌.
14일 동안 전부 무료이고 자동 결제가 없음. 14일째 아침에 '체험 전보다 잠드는 시간이 몇 분 달라졌는지' 내 기록으로 보여 주고, 그때 계속할지 고르면 됨.
계속하면 월 4,900원 또는 연 39,000원. 결제 후 30일 안에 기록이 나아지지 않으면 환불을 도와드림(안드로이드는 직접 환불, 아이폰은 애플 환불 요청 화면으로 연결).
무료로 계속 쓸 수도 있음: 기본 소리 3종과 일반 끄기 예약(30·60분).
